summary: @servicetitan/marketing-global-route preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs probes for a local `bun` binary and otherwise downloads a platform-specific Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line obfuscator.io-style bundle (rotated string array n7gIxM, hex-named _0xNNNN identifiers, control-flow-flattened dispatch) that is not referenced from dist/index.js and is loaded only via this preinstall path. The stated purpose of the package is a Marketing route helper library, which has no need for an alternate JavaScript runtime or a 700KB opaque bundle. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern bypasses scanners that inspect only Node-resolved code, and the payload's behavior is concealed by the obfuscation, so npm install of this version executes arbitrary attacker-controlled code on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
